notes.title: Raid on Area 51 Launch Day!
notes.notes: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35527140/3508fd7884c6e1ceda27c90abc472de7a10fbf21.jpg"][/img][/p][p]I've spared no expense on the full release of this incredible game just so that you can experience the thrill of defending and/or raiding Area 51. It's time to see those alien cheeks, or defend the base and keep the hipsters out. It's up to you. The aliens don't care either way. Clap them cheeks![/p]

notes.title: The first update to fix issues and add more weapons (and secrets)
notes.notes:
[u]Moved back loot drop line[/u]
Now you can get more power ups to defend from those Kyles and Karens

[u]Added ability to drop a powered item and equip the pistol [/u]
Hit "tab" to use this for faster cool down

[u]Added slow-mo on level up in infinite mode[/u]
You now have the chance to take out a few extra plebs before the next level begins

[u]Added high score tallies[/u]
See your highest total kills and level reached

[u]Adjusted spawn rate[/u]
This makes the levels feel a bit better

[u]Adjusted kill rate[/u]
Some guns are more powerful, some are less powerful

[u]Added new weapon drop[/u]
The Alien Laser Rifle is very powerful and will keep shooting if overheated, but switching to another weapon keeps the heat

[u]Added more secrets[/u]
You just have to find them

[u]Adjusted cool down of all weapons[/u]
The pistol cools down faster, but the others heat up a bit quicker

[u]Small graphical modifications[/u]
Just cleaning up
